title: Solar Energy Installation Managers
description: Direct work crews installing residential or commercial solar photovoltaic or thermal systems.

tasks.text: Prepare solar installation project proposals, quotes, budgets, or schedules.
Perform start-up of systems for testing or customer implementation.
Identify means to reduce costs, minimize risks, or increase efficiency of solar installation projects.
Assess system performance or functionality at the system, subsystem, and component levels.
Assess potential solar installation sites to determine feasibility and design requirements.
Plan and coordinate installations of photovoltaic (PV) solar and solar thermal systems to ensure conformance to codes.
Estimate materials, equipment, and personnel needed for residential or commercial solar installation projects.
Develop and maintain system architecture, including all piping, instrumentation, or process flow diagrams.
Visit customer sites to determine solar system needs, requirements, or specifications.
Evaluate subcontractors or subcontractor bids for quality, cost, and reliability.
Supervise solar installers, technicians, and subcontractors for solar installation projects to ensure compliance with safety standards.
Provide technical assistance to installers, technicians, or other solar professionals in areas such as solar electric systems, solar thermal systems, electrical systems, or mechanical systems.
Coordinate or schedule building inspections for solar installation projects.
Monitor work of contractors and subcontractors to ensure projects conform to plans, specifications, schedules, or budgets.
Purchase or rent equipment for solar energy system installation.

skills.name: Critical Thinking

skills.name: Persuasion

skills.name: Negotiation

skills.name: Quality Control Analysis

skills.name: Writing

skills.name: Computer aided design CAD software
skills.def: Software to design 2D or 3D objects. May include engineering or architectural features. Examples: Autodesk AutoCAD, Autodesk AutoCAD Civil 3D, Autodesk Revit, Bentley STAAD.

skills.name: Project management software
skills.def: Software to plan, organize, staff, or control the completion of a product or set of tasks. Examples: Cost estimating software, Microsoft Project, Oracle Primavera Enterprise Project Portfolio Management, Oracle Primavera Systems.

skills.name: Analytical or scientific software
skills.def: Software to capture data, perform analysis, or generate reports or visualizations to support scientific research. Examples: Minitab, Procore software, PVsyst.

skills.name: Operating system software
skills.def: Software to provide the operational interface to a computer and provide higher-level services and APIs. Examples: Microsoft Windows, Real time operating system RTOS software.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.
